fields.description: Issue includes an editorial criticizing a Dade County grand jury investigation and alleging politically motivated enforcement actions related to gambling, with discussion of State's Attorney Vernon Hawthorne, County Attorney Fred Pine, and State Senator Hayes Lewis. Also covers Miami Beach politics and law enforcement, reports and commentary on racing (Hialeah Park horse racing and Biscayne Kennel Club greyhound racing), and contains nightlife/entertainment items, local gossip columns, and numerous advertisements for clubs, bars, restaurants, and services in Miami and Miami Beach.
